claim: When an acceptance drive uses a real LLM author, it walks the journey in one conversation, with explicit 'continue' answers, re-reading the document path by id, and choosing the delivery itself.

citations.quote: When an acceptance drive uses a real LLM author, the spec should say how the drive walks the journey: one conversation, explicit 'continue' answers, re-reading the document path by id, and choosing the delivery itself.
